// ========================================
// CS2 Autoexec Configuration
// Generated by CS2 Config Generator
// Made by LaGgIs
// ========================================

// ========================================
// NETWORK SETTINGS
// ========================================

rate "1000000"  // Max bandwidth (1000000 = 1MB/s)
mm_dedicated_search_maxping "50"  // Max ping for matchmaking
cl_resend "6"  // Packet resend count
cl_net_buffer_ticks "0"  // Set to 1 or 2 if you have packet loss
cl_timeout "30"  // Connection timeout in seconds
cq_buffer_bloat_msecs_max "64"  // Maximum buffer bloat before reset
net_client_steamdatagram_enable_override "-1"  // Steam Datagram Relay setting
cl_predict_body_shot_fx "false"  // Predict body shot effects
cl_predict_head_shot_fx "false"  // Predict headshot effects
cl_predict_kill_ragdolls "true"  // Predict kill ragdolls
cl_net_buffer_ticks_use_interp "1"  // Use interpolation for network buffer ticks
cl_interp_ratio "1"  // Interpolation ratio for network smoothing
cl_tickpacket_desired_queuelength "0"  // Desired queue length for tick packets
mm_session_search_qos_timeout "20"  // QoS timeout for session search
mm_csgo_community_search_players_min "3"  // Minimum players for community search
lobby_default_privacy_bits2 "0"  // Default lobby privacy settings
ui_setting_advertiseforhire_auto "1"  // Auto advertise for hire
cl_invites_only_friends "0"  // Restrict invites to friends only
cl_invites_only_mainmenu "0"  // Only allow invites in main menu

// ========================================
// PERFORMANCE & FPS OPTIMIZATION
// ========================================

fps_max "0"  // Maximum FPS (0 = unlimited)
cl_disable_ragdolls "1"  // Disable ragdoll physics
vprof_off "1"  // Disable visual profiling tool
fps_max_ui "400"  // Maximum FPS for UI elements
fps_max_tools "300"  // Maximum FPS for tools/menus
thread_pool_option "2"  // Thread pool configuration
engine_low_latency_sleep_after_client_tick "1"  // Low latency sleep
engine_no_focus_sleep "0"  // Sleep when game loses focus
r_fullscreen_gamma "2.2"  // Gamma correction for fullscreen mode
cl_particle_fallback_base "0"  // Particle system fallback base
cl_particle_fallback_multiplier "1"  // Particle fallback multiplier
r_low_latency "0"  // Renderer low latency
r_low_latency_wait "0"  // Renderer low latency wait
r_player_visibility_mode "1"  // Enhanced player visibility

// ========================================
// PRO SETTINGS - MOUSE & VIEWMODEL
// ========================================

sensitivity "2.0"  // Pro mouse sensitivity (m0NESY: 2.3, donk: 1.25)
zoom_sensitivity_ratio "1.0"  // Pro scoped sensitivity multiplier
viewmodel_fov "68"  // Pro viewmodel FOV (m0NESY & donk: 68)
viewmodel_offset_x "2.5"  // Pro viewmodel X position (m0NESY & donk: 2.5)
viewmodel_offset_y "0"  // Pro viewmodel Y position (m0NESY & donk: 0)
viewmodel_offset_z "-1.5"  // Pro viewmodel Z position (m0NESY & donk: -1.5)
viewmodel_presetpos "3"  // Pro viewmodel preset (m0NESY: 3, donk: 2)

// ========================================
// MOUSE SETTINGS
// ========================================

sensitivity "1.6"  // Mouse sensitivity
zoom_sensitivity_ratio "1"  // Scoped sensitivity
m_pitch "0.022"  // Vertical sensitivity multiplier
m_yaw "0.022"  // Horizontal sensitivity multiplier

// ========================================
// AUDIO SETTINGS
// ========================================

volume "0.5"  // Master volume
snd_musicvolume "0.5"  // Music volume
snd_voipvolume "0.4"  // Voice chat volume
snd_headphone_eq "0"  // Headphone EQ
snd_roundend_volume "0"  // Round end music
snd_mvp_volume "0"  // MVP music
snd_spatialize_lerp "0.5"  // Sound panning
snd_steamaudio_enable_perspective_correction "1"  // Steam Audio perspective
snd_steamaudio_reverb_level_db "-3"  // Steam Audio reverb
snd_autodetect_latency "1"  // Auto-detect latency
snd_surround_speakers "0"  // Force Stereo (0) recommended for clarity
snd_mixahead "0.05"  // Audio buffer mix ahead
snd_menumusic_volume "0.04"  // Menu music volume
snd_menumap_volume "0.8"  // Menu map volume
snd_roundstart_volume "0.0"  // Round start volume
snd_mapobjective_volume "0.0"  // Map objective volume
snd_deathcamera_volume "0.0"  // Death camera volume
snd_tensecondwarning_volume "0.5"  // 10-second warning volume
snd_mute_mvp_music_live_players "1"  // Mute MVP music when alive
snd_mute_losefocus "1"  // Mute when unfocused
snd_toolvolume "0.3"  // Tool volume
cl_embedded_stream_audio_volume "0.0"  // Embedded stream audio
cl_embedded_stream_audio_volume_xmaster "1"  // Stream audio master
cl_mute_enemy_team "0"  // Mute enemy team
cl_mute_all_but_friends_and_party "0"  // Mute all but friends
cl_clutch_mode "0"  // Clutch mode
voice_loopback "0"  // Voice loopback
voice_threshold "-110"  // Voice threshold
voice_modenable "1"  // Voice mode enable
voice_always_sample_mic "0"  // Always sample mic
voice_device_override "0"  // Voice device override

// ========================================
// HUD & INTERFACE SETTINGS
// ========================================

hud_scaling "0.95"  // HUD scale
cl_hud_color "0"  // HUD color scheme (Note: Blue may appear white in some CS2 versions)
cl_hud_radar_scale "1.15"  // Radar HUD element size
cl_radar_scale "0.4"  // Radar zoom level
cl_radar_always_centered "0"  // Radar centering
cl_radar_rotate "1"  // Radar rotation
cl_showfps "0"  // Show FPS counter
r_player_visibility_mode "1"  // Player visibility
cl_autohelp "0"  // Auto help messages
cl_color "2"  // Teammate color on radar and Steam avatar
cl_weapon_selection_rarity_color "0"  // Weapon rarity colors
cl_sanitize_player_names "0"  // Sanitize player names
cl_hide_avatar_images "0"  // Hide avatar images
cl_allow_animated_avatars "0"  // Animated avatars
cl_teamcounter_playercount_instead_of_avatars "1"  // Team counter display
cl_hud_radar_background_alpha "1"  // Radar background transparency
cl_teammate_colors_show "1"  // Teammate colors
cl_teamid_overhead_mode "2"  // Team ID overhead mode
cl_showloadout "1"  // Show loadout
cl_prefer_lefthanded "0"  // Left-handed viewmodel
cl_hud_telemetry_frametime_show "0"  // HUD telemetry frametime
cl_hud_telemetry_net_misdelivery_show "0"  // HUD telemetry network
cl_hud_telemetry_ping_show "0"  // HUD telemetry ping
ui_steam_overlay_notification_position "topright"  // Steam overlay position
cl_show_observer_crosshair "0"  // Observer crosshair
spec_show_xray "1"  // Spectator X-ray
player_nevershow_communityservermessage "1"  // Hide community server messages
cl_sanitize_muted_players "1"  // Sanitize muted player names
cl_hud_radar_map_additive "1"  // Radar map additive
cl_radar_scale_alternate "1"  // Radar scale alternate
cl_radar_icon_scale_min "0.7"  // Radar icon scale minimum
cl_radar_square_with_scoreboard "0"  // Radar square with scoreboard
cl_player_ping_mute "0"  // Player ping mute
cl_drawhud_force_deathnotices "0"  // Force death notices
cl_drawhud_force_radar "0"  // Force radar
cl_drawhud_force_teamid_overhead "0"  // Force team ID overhead
cl_draw_only_deathnotices "0"  // Draw only death notices
cl_show_clan_in_death_notice "0"  // Show clan in death notice
cl_drawhud_specvote "1"  // Draw HUD spec vote
cl_observed_bot_crosshair "1"  // Observed bot crosshair
cl_teamid_overhead_colors_show "1"  // Team ID overhead colors
+cl_show_team_equipment "1"  // Show teammate equipment
cl_teamid_overhead_fade_near_crosshair "1"  // Team ID overhead fade near crosshair
cl_deathnotices_show_numbers "0"  // Death notices show numbers
cl_scoreboard_survivors_always_on "0"  // Scoreboard survivors always on
cl_spec_stats "1"  // Spectator stats
cl_spec_show_bindings "1"  // Spectator show bindings
spec_usenumberkeys_nobinds "1"  // Spectator use number keys no binds
cl_obs_interp_enable "1"  // Observer interpolation enable
tv_nochat "0"  // TV no chat
tv_secure_bypass "0"  // TV secure bypass
spec_replay_autostart "0"  // Spectator replay autostart
spec_replay_bot "0"  // Spectator replay bot
spec_replay_winddown_time "2"  // Spectator replay winddown time
spec_glow_silent_factor "0.4"  // Spectator glow silent factor
spec_glow_spike_time "0"  // Spectator glow spike time
spec_glow_full_time "1"  // Spectator glow full time
spec_glow_decay_time "2"  // Spectator glow decay time
demo_ui_mode "3"  // Demo UI mode
cl_demo_predict "1"  // Demo client-side prediction
ui_steam_overlay_notification_position_horz "0"  // Steam overlay notification position horizontal
ui_steam_overlay_notification_position_vert "0"  // Steam overlay notification position vertical
cl_hud_telemetry_net_misdelivery_poor "5"  // HUD telemetry network misdelivery poor threshold
cl_hud_telemetry_frametime_poor "100"  // HUD telemetry frametime poor threshold
cl_hud_telemetry_ping_poor "60"  // HUD telemetry ping poor threshold
cl_hud_telemetry_serverrecvmargin_graph_show "0"  // HUD telemetry server receive margin graph
cl_hud_telemetry_net_detailed "0"  // HUD telemetry network detailed
cl_hud_telemetry_net_quality_graph_show "0"  // HUD telemetry network quality graph
cl_ticks_net_print_threshold "2"  // Network ticks print threshold
cl_frametime_summary_report_detailed "1"  // Frametime summary report detailed
safezonex "0.97"  // Safe zone X
safezoney "1"  // Safe zone Y
eom_local_player_defeat_anim_enabled "1"  // End of match defeat animation

// ========================================
// VIEWMODEL SETTINGS
// ========================================

viewmodel_presetpos "2"  // Viewmodel preset position
viewmodel_fov "68"  // Viewmodel field of view
viewmodel_offset_x "1.5"  // Viewmodel X offset
viewmodel_offset_y "0"  // Viewmodel Y offset
viewmodel_offset_z "-2"  // Viewmodel Z offset

// ========================================
// CROSSHAIR SETTINGS
// ========================================

cl_crosshairsize "4"  // Crosshair size
cl_crosshairthickness "1"  // Crosshair thickness
cl_crosshairgap "-1"  // Crosshair gap
cl_crosshaircolor "1"  // Crosshair color
cl_crosshair_drawoutline "1"  // Crosshair outline
cl_crosshairstyle "1"  // Crosshair style
cl_crosshair_recoil "0"  // Crosshair recoil
cl_crosshairgap_useweaponvalue "0"  // Use weapon gap value
cl_fixedcrosshairgap "-3"  // Fixed crosshair gap
cl_crosshairdot "0"  // Crosshair dot
cl_crosshair_t "0"  // T-style crosshair
cl_crosshaircolor_R "0"  // Crosshair red color
cl_crosshaircolor_G "255"  // Crosshair green color
cl_crosshaircolor_B "0"  // Crosshair blue color
hud_showtargetid "1"  // Show target ID
cl_crosshair_friendly_warning "1"  // Friendly warning
cl_ironsight_usecrosshaircolor "0"  // Iron sight crosshair color
cl_ironsight_dot_scale "1.0"  // Iron sight dot scale
cl_crosshair_sniper_width "1"  // Sniper crosshair width
cl_crosshair_dynamic_maxdist_splitratio "2"  // Dynamic max distance split ratio
cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_innermod "0"  // Dynamic split alpha inner mod
cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_outermod "1"  // Dynamic split alpha outer mod
cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitdist "3"  // Dynamic split distance
cl_grenadecrosshair_decoy "0"  // Decoy grenade crosshair
cl_grenadecrosshair_explosive "1"  // Explosive grenade crosshair
cl_grenadecrosshair_fire "1"  // Fire grenade crosshair
cl_grenadecrosshair_flash "1"  // Flash grenade crosshair
cl_grenadecrosshair_smoke "1"  // Smoke grenade crosshair
cl_grenadecrosshair_keepusercrosshair "0"  // Keep user crosshair for grenades
cl_grenadecrosshairdelay_decoy "2"  // Decoy grenade crosshair delay
cl_grenadecrosshairdelay_explosive "2"  // Explosive grenade crosshair delay
cl_grenadecrosshairdelay_fire "2"  // Fire grenade crosshair delay
cl_grenadecrosshairdelay_flash "2"  // Flash grenade crosshair delay
cl_grenadecrosshairdelay_smoke "2"  // Smoke grenade crosshair delay
cl_crosshair_outlinethickness "1"  // Crosshair outline thickness
cl_crosshairusealpha "1"  // Use crosshair alpha
cl_crosshairalpha "255"  // Crosshair alpha value

// ========================================
// VISUAL EFFECTS SETTINGS
// ========================================

r_drawparticles "1"  // Draw particle effects
r_drawtracers_firstperson "1"  // Show bullet tracers in first person view
r_csgo_render_decals "1"  // Render decals (blood, bullet holes, scorch marks)
fog_override "0"  // Override automatic fog settings
animated_material_attributes "1"  // Animated material effects

// ========================================
// ADVANCED SETTINGS

violence_hblood "1"  // Blood effects
cl_join_advertise "2"  // Join advertising
con_enable "1"  // Enable console
cl_graphics_driver_warning_dont_show_again "0"  // Graphics driver warning
cl_vrr_recommendation_dont_show_again "0"  // VRR recommendation
cl_refresh_rate_recommendation_dont_show_again "0"  // Refresh rate recommendation
cl_low_latency_vsync_recommendation_dont_show_again "0"  // Low latency VSync recommendation
cl_dm_buyrandomweapons "0"  // Disable random weapon buying in DM
gameinstructor_enable "0"  // Disable game instructor
cl_autohelp "0"  // Disable automatic help messages

// ========================================

demo_flush "0"  // Demo flush setting
tv_listen_voice_indices_h "-1"  // Disable HLTV voice chat filtering (hear all players)
tv_listen_voice_indices "-1"  // Disable demo voice chat filtering (hear all players)

// PRACTICE & TRAINING SETTINGS
// ========================================

bot_difficulty "0"  // Bot difficulty level

// Practice Commands (Requires sv_cheats 1)
mp_buytime "15"  // Buy time in seconds
mp_roundtime "2"  // Round time in minutes
mp_maxmoney "16000"  // Maximum money
mp_startmoney "800"  // Starting money

// ========================================
// SAVE CONFIG & CONFIRMATION
// ========================================

host_writeconfig  // Save settings
echo "CS2 Competitive Config Loaded Successfully! By LaGgIs"
